title: Secret Sauce simulation vocabulary
description: simData/vocab.json — the tag vocabulary and the generic title-variant templates. Not read at runtime: tool/sim.dart validates this file and generates supabase/sim/1_sim_vocab.sql from it, and `melos run sim:check` fails when that .sql is stale. No JSON Schema library is in the toolchain, so every rule here is ALSO implemented in tool/sim.dart — change both.

note.description: Free prose for whoever opens the file. Ignored by the generator.

tags.description: ARRAY ORDER IS RANK, and rank is the only weight there is. The generator draws a rank with sim.rand_zipf(), so entry 1 lands on a large fraction of the population and the tail lands on one or two recipes. There is deliberately no per-tag `weight`: two ways to say how common a tag is would drift apart, and the Zipf draw is the one the roadmap asked for.

name.description: Lowercase, hyphenated. Becomes a row in the shared `public.tags` table (unique by name), so it is also what search matches on — `recipe_search_tsv` folds tag names into a recipe's document.

categories.description: Optional. When present, the tag may only land on a recipe whose `category` is in this list — `no-bake` belongs on a Dessert, not on a Soup. Absent means any category. The generator re-ranks the ELIGIBLE tags densely per category before drawing, so restricting a tag does not leave holes in the Zipf ladder.

title_variants.description: The GENERIC title templates, appended after a dish's own `sim.variant_titles` and de-duplicated against them. Each is indexed by an owner's occurrence of that dish, rotated by a Zipf-drawn offset, which is what keeps `(owner_id, title)` — the import key — unique within one owner (SDS §11.2, check D4).

items.description: Must contain the literal `{title}` — it is a template, not a title.
